cues.zh: 也許，嵌入空間中對應語意的軸，其實高度非線性，

cues.en: curved, looping back on themselves and other kinds of weird shapes.
cues.zh: 會彎曲、迴繞，還有其他奇怪形狀。

cues.en: But maybe there are segments of these functions that are linear, or at least are close enough to being linear, that they can be understood with linear analyses.
cues.zh: 但也許，這些函數中有某些區段是線性的，或至少夠接近線性，可以用線性分析理解。

cues.en: A second general point I'd like to make is that science communication is often guilty of oversimplification and overgeneralization.
cues.zh: 第二點是，科學傳播經常過度簡化、過度概括。

cues.en: It makes for very catchy, clickbait worthy headlines to say that these models will do seemingly very human capacity.
cues.zh: 聲稱這些模型能做到看似很像人類能力的事情，很容易寫成吸引人、值得點擊的標題。

cues.en: Analogies like king minus man plus woman equals queen.
cues.zh: 例如 king 減 man 加 woman 等於 queen 這種類比。

cues.en: Now, you saw in the code that we can reproduce that result, but you also saw other cases where that approach just didn't generalize or gave completely uninterpretable results.
cues.zh: 程式中，你看到可以重現這個結果，但也看到其他例子，這個方法完全無法泛化，或得到完全無法解讀的結果。

cues.en: Language is complicated.
cues.zh: 語言很複雜。

cues.en: There is a reason why humans are the only species on Earth that can use abstract, flexible, and referential language.
cues.zh: 人類是地球上唯一能使用抽象、靈活、具有指涉性的語言的物種，這是有原因的。

cues.en: Now, I'm not just talking about basic communication, which most animals, even single celled organisms,
cues.zh: 我不是只指基本溝通，多數動物，甚至單細胞生物，

cues.en: can do to some extent, but language as we use it for abstract communication is complicated and it's messy.
cues.zh: 某種程度都做得到；但我們用來抽象溝通的語言，非常複雜、混亂。

cues.en: And these models are also very complicated.
cues.zh: 這些模型也很複雜。

cues.en: Large language models like GPT are very complicated.
cues.zh: GPT 這類大型語言模型很複雜。

cues.en: So any time you come across someone saying that they have a very simple explanation for a very complicated
cues.zh: 所以，每當有人說，能用非常簡單的方式解釋非常複雜的

cues.en: thing, you should view it with a great deal of skepticism and ask yourself whether such a complicated
cues.zh: 事情，你都應高度懷疑，問自己，這麼複雜的

cues.en: thing, like a language model, really can have such a simple explanation, and yet still be so sophisticated.
cues.zh: 東西，例如語言模型，真的能有那麼簡單的解釋，卻又如此精密嗎？

cues.en: Well, in the specific case of language models and AI, a risk of relying too much on the assumption
cues.zh: 尤其對語言模型與 AI，太依賴線性

cues.en: of linearity is that it will lull us into complacency, that we're really understanding a complex system when we're really not understanding it.
cues.zh: 假設的風險，是讓我們安於現狀，以為真的理解了複雜系統，但其實沒有。

cues.en: And I think that has important implications for AI safety.
cues.zh: 我認為，這對 AI 安全有重要意涵。
